description_en: Queries a list of containers based on the group type
description_zh: 根据分组类型查询对应的容器列表信息
name: DescribeGroupedContainerInstances

parameters.help_en:
The conditions for searching assets. The value is in JSON format. Separate multiple conditions with commas (,). Example: `[{"name":"riskStatus","value":"YES"},{"name":"riskLevel","value":"2"}]`.
You can search for assets by using conditions such as the instance ID, instance name, VPC ID, region, and public IP address. You can call the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions
parameters.help_zh:
设置搜索资产的条件。该参数为JSON格式，多个条件之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。例如：`[{"name":"riskStatus","value":"YES"},{"name":"riskLevel","value":"2"}]`。
支持使用实例ID、实例名称、所属VPC ID、地域、公网IP地址等条件搜索资产。您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)查询支持的搜索条件
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship among multiple search conditions. Valid values:
OR: The logical relationship among multiple conditions is OR.
AND: The logical relationship among multiple conditions is AND
parameters.help_zh:
设置多个搜索条件间生效的逻辑关系。取值：
OR：表示多个条件间为或的关系。
AND：表示多个条件间为与的关系
parameters.name: logical_exp

parameters.help_en:
The group type to query. Valid values:
pod: pod.
appName: application name.
namespace: namespace.
clusterId: cluster ID.
image: image
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的分组类型。取值：
pod：容器组。
appName：应用名称。
namespace：命名空间。
clusterId：集群ID。
image：镜像
parameters.name: group_field

parameters.help_en:
The search condition for different group types. Specify the search condition based on the value of GroupField:
If GroupField is set to pod, specify the name of the pod to query.
If GroupField is set to appName, specify the name of the application to query.
If GroupField is set to namespace, specify the namespace to query.
If GroupField is set to clusterId, specify the ID of the cluster to query.
If GroupField is set to image, specify the name of the image to query.
Fuzzy search is supported for all the preceding search conditions
parameters.help_zh:
设置不同分组类型的搜索条件。根据GroupField选择的类型您需要设置以下搜索条件：
GroupField选择为pod：指定要查询的容器组名称。
GroupField选择为appName：指定要查询的应用名称。
GroupField选择为namespace：指定要查询的命名空间。
GroupField选择为clusterId：指定要查询的集群ID。
GroupField选择为image：指定要查询的镜像名称。
以上搜索条件均支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: field_value

parameters.help_en:
Settings for paging in a paged query, specifying the number of container assets to return on each page. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 container asset entries are displayed on each page.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
设置分页查询时，每页显示的容器资产的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条容器资产信息。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the unified multi-cloud directory. This parameter takes effect only when GroupField is set to clusterId. If this parameter is omitted or set to false, the historical query logic is used
parameters.help_zh: 仅GroupField=clusterId时启用统一多云目录；省略或false维持历史查询
parameters.name: include_multicloud
